nodes.npc: Hi! What would you like?
nodes.npcZh: 嗨！你想喝什麼？

replies.en: A cup of tea, please.

nodes.npc: Small or large?
nodes.npcZh: 小杯還是大杯？

replies.en: Small, please.
Large, please.

nodes.npc: A small tea. That is two dollars.
nodes.npcZh: 小杯茶，兩元。

replies.en: OK, thank you.

nodes.npc: A large tea. That is three dollars.
nodes.npcZh: 大杯茶，三元。

replies.en: OK, thank you.

nodes.npc: Would you like to sit here?
nodes.npcZh: 你要坐在這裡喝嗎？

replies.en: Yes, please.
No, I will take it with me.

nodes.npc: How would you like to pay?
nodes.npcZh: 你想怎麼付款？

replies.en: Here is my card.
Here is the money.

nodes.npc: Thank you. Your tea will be ready soon.
nodes.npcZh: 謝謝。你的茶很快就好。

replies.en: Great. I will wait here.

nodes.npc: Here you are. Have a nice day!
nodes.npcZh: 這是你的茶。祝你有美好的一天！

replies.en: Thank you. You too!

nodes.npc: Hi! What would you like today?
nodes.npcZh: 嗨！今天想點什麼？

replies.en: Could I get an iced latte, please?
replies.zh: 我想要一杯冰拿鐵，謝謝。

nodes.npc: Would you like less ice or the usual amount?
nodes.npcZh: 你想要少冰，還是正常冰？

replies.en: Less ice, please.
The usual amount is fine.

nodes.npc: No problem. Would you like regular milk or oat milk?
nodes.npcZh: 沒問題。你要一般牛奶還是燕麥奶？

replies.en: Could I have oat milk instead?
replies.zh: 可以幫我換成燕麥奶嗎？

replies.en: Regular milk is fine, thanks.

nodes.npc: Oat milk it is. There's a small extra charge. Is that okay?
nodes.npcZh: 幫你換燕麥奶，會加收一點費用，可以嗎？

replies.en: Yes, that's fine.

nodes.npc: Regular milk, got it. Anything to eat with that?
nodes.npcZh: 一般牛奶，沒問題。要搭配點吃的嗎？

replies.en: Yes, what do you recommend?

nodes.npc: Our banana bread is really popular. Would you like a slice?
nodes.npcZh: 我們的香蕉蛋糕很受歡迎。要來一片嗎？

replies.en: Yes, I'll have a slice, please.
Just the latte for now, thanks.

nodes.npc: Great. You can tap your card whenever you're ready.
nodes.npcZh: 好的。準備好了就可以感應付款。

replies.en: Here you go. Thank you.

nodes.npc: Thanks! We'll call you when your order is ready.
nodes.npcZh: 謝謝！餐點好了會叫你。

replies.en: Great, I'll wait over there.

scenarios.title: A mix-up, Wi-Fi, and a chat

nodes.npc: Hi! Is everything okay with your order?
nodes.npcZh: 嗨！你的餐點都還好嗎？

replies.en: Excuse me, I think I got the wrong drink.
replies.zh: 不好意思，我好像拿到錯的飲料了。

nodes.npc: I'm sorry about that. What did you order?
nodes.npcZh: 真不好意思。你原本點的是什麼呢？

replies.en: I ordered an iced latte, but this is hot.
replies.zh: 我點的是冰拿鐵，但這杯是熱的。

nodes.npc: Thanks for letting me know. Would you like a replacement or a refund?
nodes.npcZh: 謝謝你告訴我。你想換一杯，還是辦理退款？

replies.en: Could you make me an iced one, please?
replies.zh: 可以幫我重做一杯冰的嗎？

replies.en: I'd prefer a refund, please.

nodes.npc: Absolutely. We'll remake it right away. Can I help with anything else while you wait?
nodes.npcZh: 當然，我們馬上重做。等待時還有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

replies.en: Yes, do you have Wi-Fi?
replies.zh: 有的，請問這裡有 Wi-Fi 嗎？

nodes.npc: Of course. I've refunded your payment. Is there anything else I can help with?
nodes.npcZh: 好的，已經幫你退款了。還有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

replies.en: Yes, could I use the Wi-Fi before I go?
replies.zh: 有的，我離開前可以用一下 Wi-Fi 嗎？

nodes.npc: Sure! The network is LittleTown Guest. Do you need the password?
nodes.npcZh: 可以！網路名稱是 LittleTown Guest。需要密碼嗎？

replies.en: Yes, what's the password, please?

nodes.npc: It's coffee2026, all lowercase. Are you visiting the neighborhood?
nodes.npcZh: 密碼是 coffee2026，全部小寫。你是來附近玩的嗎？

replies.en: Yes, I'm exploring the area. Any places you'd recommend?
replies.zh: 對，我正在逛這附近。你有推薦的地方嗎？

replies.en: Actually, I study nearby. This is a nice place to take a break.
replies.zh: 其實我在附近讀書，這裡很適合休息。

nodes.npc: The town park is lovely. And you're always welcome to take a break here!
nodes.npcZh: 小鎮公園很棒，也隨時歡迎你來這裡休息！

replies.en: Thanks for the tip, and for sorting out my drink.
replies.zh: 謝謝你的推薦，也謝謝你幫我處理飲料。

scenarios.title: Coffee for the team
scenarios.titleZh: 同事外帶、發票與等待處理

nodes.npc: Good morning. What can I get started for you?
nodes.npcZh: 早安，今天想點些什麼？

replies.en: I'm picking up drinks for my team: two lattes and two black coffees, all to go.
replies.zh: 我要幫同事外帶：兩杯拿鐵、兩杯黑咖啡。

nodes.npc: Certainly. Should all four drinks be large?
nodes.npcZh: 沒問題，四杯都要大杯嗎？

replies.en: Yes, please. Could you label the cups so we can tell them apart?
replies.zh: 對，謝謝。可以在杯子上標示，方便我們分辨嗎？

nodes.npc: Of course. Would you like a regular receipt or a company invoice?
nodes.npcZh: 當然。你需要一般收據，還是公司發票？

replies.en: A company invoice, please. Could you include our tax ID, 12345675?
replies.zh: 公司發票，謝謝。請幫我打統編 12345675。

replies.en: A regular receipt is fine. This isn't a company expense.
replies.zh: 一般收據就好，這次不需要報公司費用。

nodes.npc: I've added your company tax ID to the invoice. Please check the number before paying.
nodes.npcZh: 已將公司統編打在發票上，付款前請確認號碼。

replies.en: The number is correct. I'll pay by card. How long will the order take?
replies.zh: 號碼正確，我刷卡。請問要等多久？

nodes.npc: No problem. I'll put the receipt in the bag with the drinks.
nodes.npcZh: 沒問題，我會把收據和飲料一起放進袋子。

replies.en: Thank you. I'll pay by card. How long will the order take?
replies.zh: 謝謝，我刷卡。請問要等多久？

nodes.npc: I'm sorry, we're running behind. It'll be about fifteen minutes.
nodes.npcZh: 不好意思，目前出餐比較慢，大約要十五分鐘。

replies.en: We have a meeting soon. Is there any way to have the coffees ready first?
replies.zh: 我們等一下有會議。可以先做好黑咖啡嗎？

nodes.npc: Yes. The black coffees can be ready in two minutes, and we'll bring the lattes out as soon as possible.
nodes.npcZh: 可以，黑咖啡兩分鐘內就好，拿鐵也會盡快送出來。

replies.en: That works. Please keep all four drinks under the same order.
replies.zh: 這樣可以，請把四杯保留在同一筆訂單裡。

nodes.npc: Absolutely. Thanks for your patience. We'll call you when the rest is ready.
nodes.npcZh: 當然，謝謝你的耐心。其他飲料好了會叫你。

replies.en: Thanks for helping us work around the delay.
replies.zh: 謝謝你幫我們協調等候時間。
